why: EFFECT: “When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has ~~DEFF DREAD~~: On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.” The gist has the same condition (“a model in your unit”, “not selected to fight this phase”), the same roll (“roll one D6”, “on a 4+”) and the same removal timing (“until A or B” means whichever comes first), so nothing is added or changed. It leaves out only “with +3 to the result if your unit has ~~DEFF DREAD~~”, which is allowed because the gist ends with “…”. Leaving it out also avoids deciding what the strikethrough means; the gist does not resolve it. The gist is 144 chars, over the ~110 aim, but every shorter cut would drop a condition or the removal timing. text: same words as Wahapedia; the only difference is markup, the app has ~~**DEFF DREAD**~~ where Wahapedia has ~~DEFF DREAD~~ (bold inside the strikethrough).
